apps.name: WQ Files
apps.subtitle: File manager for iOS 26 and 27 (worse_query)
apps.localizedDescription:
File browser, app data manager and cache cleaner for iOS 26 and 27, built on the worse_query sandbox technique. No jailbreak and no kernel exploit.

• Browse every app's data container, app groups, extension and daemon containers
• Plist editor and hex viewer/editor; edits are backed up first
• Select, move across apps, compress and extract ZIPs; import files and whole folders
• Syntax highlighting, SQLite viewer and media player
• Back up, restore and clear app data; AirDrop backups as ZIP
• Cache cleaner

iOS 27 (tested on 27.0.1 and 27.2), preliminary support for iOS 26 (tested on 26.7.1; System Data, System Groups and app icons are not available there). Needs a signer that keeps the App Group entitlement (AltStore, SideStore or Impactor; not Sideloadly).

versions.localizedDescription: New: startup check (stops with what failed instead of empty lists when access breaks), Recently Deleted under Backups. Cache Cleaner progress bar.
New: edit SQLite databases (Edit, then Save writes back with a backup and integrity check). Korean translation. Fixed: Arabic corrections, empty app lists after an iOS update.

Now in Simplified Chinese, Arabic, German, Italian and Spanish, with a Language setting. New: Import as Backup, Keep Data Before Restore, media streams instead of copying, offloaded apps and App Bundles (iOS 27). Apps and the Cache Cleaner reopen instantly.

Select, move across apps, compress and extract ZIPs; import several files or whole folders. New: syntax highlighting, media player, Apps filter, bundle IDs and Copy Bundle ID, restore from App Backups, Allow Deleting and Show Item Counts settings. Fixed: iOS 26.5 app list, deleting locked files. Signing: use AltStore, SideStore or Impactor (Sideloadly drops the App Group).

Apps show up in seconds on every iOS version (no more long first scan); full scans only when needed and after you agree. New: sorting, A–Z sidebar, read-only SQLite viewer, swipe to delete, signing check at launch. Preliminary iOS 26 support.
iOS 27.2: app names are back. iOS 26 (26.0 – 26.7.2) is supported. Faster scans that are remembered, swipe to delete in the file browser, and a more detailed Log.
Cooler, faster scans (one shared pass, fewer cores); manage and delete backups, stop a cache clean, cancel ZIP exports; checked backups and restores; signing help in the README. Requires iOS 27.
AltStore/SideStore source; safer saves and restores (rollback, interrupted-restore recovery, no overwriting changed files); Log shows version, device and iOS.
Plist editor, hex viewer/editor, Open As, search bar, Home button, readable paths.
Safer backups and restores; large files are streamed.
Fixed: apps you installed were missing.

apps.subtitle: Firma y administra aplicaciones en iOS 26+
apps.localizedDescription: Herramienta para firmar e instalar IPA directamente desde el iPhone. Edición Modern para iOS 26 y posteriores. La fuente no está afiliada a sus desarrolladores.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Tetherless 1.2.0

### New
- **Manage your Apple ID in the app.** A new **Settings → Developer Account** screen shows your signing certificates, App IDs, and devices — and lets you **revoke a certificate** to free up a slot, without opening the Apple Developer portal or another tool. Certificates created by other tools (Xcode, SideStore, …) are clearly labeled, and revoking the one Tetherless currently signs with warns you first.

### Downloads
- **Modern** — iOS 26 and later: `Tetherless-1.2.0-Modern.ipa`
- **Legacy** — iOS 17.4–25: `Tetherless-1.2.0-Legacy.ipa`

Not sure which? iOS 26 or newer → Modern. Otherwise → Legacy.

## Tetherless 1.1.1

### Fixed
- **App Groups now work when signing with a free Apple ID.** Apps that share data between the app and its own widgets or extensions — and apps that rely on an App Group — no longer lose that access after signing. If the app's App Group is already registered to a different Apple ID, Tetherless automatically uses a team-scoped one so signing still succeeds.
- **Custom-certificate import now accepts modern `.p12` files.** Certificates exported by newer tools (OpenSSL 3's default format) that previously failed with *"Couldn't read the .p12 certificate (Security error -26275)"* now import correctly. (Fixes [#4](https://github.com/pwnapplehat/TetherlessiOS/issues/4).)

### Downloads
- **Modern** — iOS 26 and later: `Tetherless-1.1.1-Modern.ipa`
- **Legacy** — iOS 17.4–25: `Tetherless-1.1.1-Legacy.ipa`

Not sure which? iOS 26 or newer → Modern. Otherwise → Legacy.

## Tetherless 1.1.0

### Fixed
- **File imports now work when Tetherless is installed with a re-signing tool** (eSign, KSign, SideStore, and similar). Previously, picking a file and tapping **Open** did nothing. This fix covers every import in the app — the Library and Files tabs, pairing files, custom certificates, and the Decrypt tab.

### New
- **Export Unsigned IPA** — a toggle in the Sign screen's advanced options. It applies your configuration and any tweaks, then exports an unsigned `.ipa` you can share and install elsewhere. No Apple ID, pairing, or certificate required.
- **In-app updates** — Settings → Software Update checks for new releases and downloads them straight into your Library, ready to sign and install.
- **Import confirmations** — a quick on-screen confirmation when a file is imported.

### Downloads
- **Modern** — iOS 26 and later (full Liquid Glass look): `Tetherless-1.1.0-Modern.ipa`
- **Legacy** — iOS 17.4–25 (same features, earlier iOS): `Tetherless-1.1.0-Legacy.ipa`

**Tetherless 1.0** — sideload on iPhone, with no computer at all.

Sign and install apps right on your iPhone — no Mac, no PC, no cable, and no jailbreak.

### Download

| Build | For your iPhone |
|-------|-----------------|
| **Tetherless-1.0.0-Modern.ipa** | iOS 26 and later |
| **Tetherless-1.0.0-Legacy.ipa** | iOS 17.4 and later |

If you're on iOS 26 or newer, grab **Modern**. Otherwise grab **Legacy**.

### What's inside

- **Sign & install any IPA** with your free Apple ID or your own certificate.
- **Get a clean copy of apps you own** — download from the App Store and decrypt on-device.
- **Tweak injection** (`.deb` / `.dylib`) while signing.
- **Keep apps alive** — one-tap resign before the 7-day signature expires, Tetherless included.
- **Built-in Files** and a full **custom-certificate** mode (OTA install, no pairing or VPN).

### Getting started

See the [setup guide](https://github.com/pwnapplehat/TetherlessiOS#getting-started) or visit **[tetherlessios.com](https://tetherlessios.com)**.
